intuition: Two strings are isomorphic exactly when each character in either string always maps to one unique character in the other.

brute_force.approach: Try every character substitution and compare the transformed string with the target.

optimal.approach: Track both source-to-target and target-to-source mappings while scanning aligned characters.

edge_cases: Strings of different lengths cannot be isomorphic.
Repeated source characters must map consistently.
Different source characters cannot share a target character.
